ruling: Accepted by RUL-2026-10-31-085: build-order diagnostics (validator bug).
reason: validate.py renames every asset entry to 'gameAsset' before its build-order lint, whose table is keyed 'asset', so the 11 assets rank 9 and every item/variant/ai/quest after them is flagged. The order here is the law-17 order (badge, assets, items + variant, ai, quest); the quest references the assets by @scene and the items and badge by @item/@badge, so it must run last. check_manifest.mjs: 0 pre-send problems. Validator bug, Lane A, not fixed here.
